tracks.script: 小朋友，准备好了吗？我们去和霸王龙比一比，看看它到底有多大。
先来到你身边，看看今天的探险装。现在绕到你身后，跟着你的目光，再轻轻来到你的眼睛这里。
看，霸王龙就在前面。它的腿又粗又高，我们要把眼睛抬起来，才能看到它的大脑袋。
小朋友，准备好了吗？我们在想象里穿上飞行装备，去和无齿翼龙一起飞，看看它的翅膀有多宽。
先从后上方看看你的翼装，像一只小飞鸟。无齿翼龙就在前面，准备好，我们来到你的眼睛这里啦。
看，无齿翼龙就在正前方，和我们飞得一样高。它的两只大翅膀一左一右，展开得真宽！
小朋友，准备好了吗？我们在想象里换上潜水装备，一起去看看沧龙吧。它到底有多大呢？
先游到你右边，看看潜水服和大脚蹼。再来到你身后，准备好，我们来到你的眼睛这里啦。
看，沧龙正在斜上方慢慢游过去。阳光从水面照下来，我们能看见它的肚子、四只大鳍，还有长长的尾巴。
Ready, explorer? Let’s stand beside Tyrannosaurus rex and see just how big it was.
First, let’s come alongside and see today’s explorer outfit. Now we move behind you, follow your gaze, and gently arrive at your eyes.
Look! Tyrannosaurus rex is right in front of us. Its legs are thick and tall—we have to look up to find its enormous head.
Ready, explorer? In our imagination, let’s put on flying gear and fly beside Pteranodon to see how wide its wings were.
First, let’s see your wingsuit from behind and above. Pteranodon is ahead—ready? Now we gently arrive at your eyes.
Look straight ahead! Pteranodon is right in front of us, flying at our height. Its two great wings stretch far out to either side!
Ready, explorer? In our imagination, let’s put on diving gear and find out how big Mosasaurus was.
First, we swim to your right and see the diving suit and big fins. Then we move behind you—ready? Now we arrive at your eyes.
Look! Mosasaurus is gliding past above us. Sunlight shines through the surface, and we can see its belly, four big flippers and long tail.
小朋友，穿好暖暖的羽绒服，我们去寒冷的草原上和长毛猛犸象比一比，看看它的肩膀有多高。
先来到你身边，看看羽绒服和围巾。现在绕到你身后，长毛猛犸象就在前面，我们再轻轻来到你的眼睛这里。
看，长毛猛犸象站在前面。它光是肩膀就比我们高好多，厚厚的长毛下面还有四条像柱子一样的腿。
Ready, explorer? Pull on a warm coat and come to the cold grassland to see how high a woolly mammoth’s shoulders could reach.
First, see your warm coat and scarf. Now we move behind you. The woolly mammoth is ahead, and we gently arrive at your eyes.
Look! The woolly mammoth is standing ahead. Even its shoulders rise far above us, with four pillar-like legs beneath its thick coat.
